# Travel Document Vault — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

> Travel Document Vault is a privacy-first iOS and Android app for storing family travel documents — passports, visas, IDs — on-device with AES-256 encryption, no account required, no cloud upload.

## App

- One-time purchase ($9.99), no subscription
- AES-256-GCM on-device encryption
- Works fully offline
- Supports multiple family members under one app
- Passport and visa expiry reminders with customisable lead time
- Available on App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/travel-document-vault/id6757014877
- Available on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mustafahafeez.traveldocumentvault
